items.description: The same blend for points allowed per 100 possessions (lower is better).
known_limitations: A predictive ESTIMATE, not an observation: weight on this season = n/(n+k) with k fitted on stored seasons; last season is carried over with a roster-continuity-dependent shrinkage.
Fitted on 2 season transitions (60 team-seasons); held-out RMSE at 10 games: blend 3.87, prior only 5.057, current only 3.949 (points/100 possessions).

Coaching changes are not modelled (nothing stored identifies them reliably). In-season injuries to players who have appeared are not adjusted for; a player who has not appeared lowers roster continuity.

items.description: Share of last season's minutes played by players who have appeared for the team this season (minutes-weighted). A departure or a long absence lowers it and so lowers the weight given to last season.
known_limitations: A predictive ESTIMATE, not an observation: weight on this season = n/(n+k) with k fitted on stored seasons; last season is carried over with a roster-continuity-dependent shrinkage.
Fitted on 2 season transitions (60 team-seasons); held-out RMSE at 10 games: blend 3.87, prior only 5.057, current only 3.949 (points/100 possessions).

Coaching changes are not modelled (nothing stored identifies them reliably). In-season injuries to players who have appeared are not adjusted for; a player who has not appeared lowers roster continuity.
